archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_road.1: To you who woke the ring: we felt it. Look at your hand. That glyph is the first of the marks. You came the long way, by fire, as we once did.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_road.2:
This is the Archive. Everything we were is written here, and all of it was left for you. Read slowly. There is no one left to hurry you.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_builde: We were the first people. We cut the rings and walked between worlds the way you walk between rooms.

Our children forgot us. The ones you call villagers do not even speak our words. But you are not like them. You read. You remember. You are the one we waited for.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.many_world: Count the lights on the orrery. Each was a world on our road, and each was rich beyond counting.

The burning world, where our forges made the black metal that does not burn. Seas under ice. A forge the size of a mountain range. All of it was ours. All of it is yours.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_keeper: The destroyer's beasts hold our fortress, east of the ring on the plain. They took the key to this world's ring, and they keep it still.

They will not speak. They cannot be reasoned with. Do not pity them, whatever they look like. Take back the key, and the ring will wake for you.

— Tacita
It came from the far worlds. Their rings went quiet one by one, from the outside in, as if something were walking the road toward us.

We fled home ahead of it. We could not hold the road. You can. Every ring you wake takes a world back.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_last_o: On our tallest pillar is a band of marks, one for each world on the road. When you woke your ring, the first of them lit.

Each world you wake adds a mark to your hand and lights one on the pillar. When all seven shine, you are our Heir, and our Vault will open to you. Everything we built.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_sealin: Here I hid with our record when the destroyer's creatures came for it. I walled myself in. It was not enough.

They broke through the wall. I did not survive. The record did, in you. Carry it to the end of the road.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.unfinished: Look across the hall. That was our ring. The destroyer killed it and walled it up, so that no one could ever follow us home.

It cannot be woken. But the ring on the plain, south of here, still can. Take the key from the keepers, and undo what was done to us.

— Tacita
